plugins.name: flutter-secure-dev-playbook
plugins.description: Comprehensive Flutter/Dart reference: widgets & layout, BLoC/Cubit, navigation (flow_builder/go_router), forms (formz), Material 3, REST/http, WebSockets, Firebase auth + FCM, maps (flutter_map), in-app purchase, animations, testing, performance, build/deploy — plus SOLID/Clean Architecture, OWASP MASVS/ASVS, STRIDE/PASTA threat modeling, CWE mapping, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, AAA/CIA, production security ops, resilience (BCP/DRP), and TDD/BDD/QA methodology.
